title: Software Engineer Co-op (Spring 2027)
description:
Fernway Finance is a made-up company for the coop-crew demo. It builds payment and ledger software for small banks.

This is a six-month co-op from January 4 to June 25, 2027, at our Boston office, in person four days a week.

You will join the ledger team and build features end to end: design, code, tests, release and support in production.

You will work with Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Kafka, and partner with a senior engineer on one project you own.

We look for students in a computer science or related program with one earlier internship or co-op.

Pay is $42 to $48 an hour. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US; this role does not offer visa sponsorship.
